quote: We propose an unsupervised verb metaphors detection method based on Chat-GPT.

We test our model on the VUAverb, MOH-X, and TroFi datasets, and the results show that by bootstrapping and integrating the implicit knowledge of ChatGPT, it can effectively improve performance on the verb metaphors detection task.
On the three datasets, our methods improves 29.5%, 40.8% and 37.3% on the core metric F1 compared to GPT-3.5 Turbo, respectively.
We give the manual evaluation of different categories of samples. The assessment metrics include clarity, relevance, and diversity, and each metric is rated on a scale of 1 to 5.
